items.reason: A144 sets the statutory scope of post-marketing foreign measure reports, so Mandatory.

row.title: Report these foreign measures as post-marketing foreign measure reports
row.statement: The MAH must report as foreign measures: restriction of indications or dosage for efficacy/safety reasons (not extensions); discontinuation of manufacture, import or sale or manufacturing changes for efficacy/safety reasons (not purely commercial); recalls or disposal for efficacy/safety reasons, including voluntary recalls; important changes to precautions; and suspension of an entire trial for safety reasons.

items.reason: A145 sets the statutory scope of clinical trial foreign measure reports, so Mandatory.

row.title: Report these foreign measures as clinical trial foreign measure reports
row.statement: The sponsor must report as foreign measures: changes or restrictions of indication or dosage for efficacy/safety; discontinuation or manufacturing changes for lack of efficacy or safety; recalls/disposal for efficacy or safety (including voluntary); important precaution changes; suspension or termination of the whole trial for quality, efficacy or safety; and strengthened safety measures such as Dear Doctor letters during the trial.
